title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in December
author: Allison
description: We will deprecate the following models across all GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions) on December 14, 2026: Model Deprecation date… The post Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in December appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: The deprecation of Claude Haiku 4.5 does not apply to these customers. Please update your workflows and integrations to use the supported models before this date.
takeaways: Under default model enablement, the suggested alternatives are automatically enabled for Copilot Enterprise and Copilot Business customers unless an administrator has turned off the global default or explicitly disabled the model.
Once enabled, users will see the model in the Copilot Chat model selector in supported GitHub Copilot experiences.
